title: [PM-43142] Vault owned importer changes
body:
## 🎟️ Tracking

https://bitwarden.atlassian.net/browse/PM-43142

## 📔 Objective

This PR updates Vault owned UI elements to point to the upgraded import experience, which has been introduced in https://github.com/bitwarden/clients/pull/23031.

reviews.body: Changes look good from a vault perspective. You have conflicts from the pre-filled implementation that you reviewed previously! https://github.com/bitwarden/clients/pull/23345
🙌 Thank you for adding that ticket!

inline.body:
❓ **QUESTION**: The VFO1 empty-state "Import items" button still links to `/import` directly — intentional?

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

`vault-popup-list-table.component.html:115` is the third Vault-owned import entry point in the popup, and it still uses `routerLink="/import"` rather than going through `ImportUpgradeNavigationService`.

With the flag on it does reach the new picker, but only via `importUpgradeRedirectGuard`, which opens the tab and then bounces the popup to `/tabs/vault`. That guard's docstring says "the two known entry points into this route already check the flag themselves before navigating here" — this PR makes that true for the empty-vault nudge callout and the vault settings entry, leaving this one relying on the safety net.

Was that deliberate (the redirect lands on `/tabs/vault`, which is where this button already lives, so the difference is invisible), or should it call `openImportSourceSelectTab()` as well?
</details>

## 🤖 Bitwarden Claude Code Review

**Overall Assessment:** APPROVE

This PR points four Vault-owned import entry points (browser popup vault callout, browser vault settings, desktop vault v3, web vault-next) at the upgraded import experience behind `FeatureFlag.ImportUpgrade`. I verified every flag-on destination resolves: the browser `/import-source-select` route and `ImportUpgradeNavigationService` exist, the desktop `/import` route sits under the root `DesktopLayoutComponent` path with a matching `canMatch` flag guard, and web `/tools/import` resolves to the new picker when the flag is on and the legacy `ImportWebComponent` when it is off. The flag-check pattern matches the existing implementations in `desktop-layout.component.ts` and the desktop `app.component.ts` `importVault` menu handler, and the `openImportDialog` → `openImport` rename has no stale references left. Browser and web branches both gained tests; the desktop branch is the one path without coverage (codecov reports its 3 new lines uncovered).
